arStrings.szText: Collect {c_highlight}Trace of Echos{/c} to activate the {c_highlight}Sightless Eye{/c} to open a portal into the {icon:Marker_Dungeon_EchoesofAbyss, 2.0} {c_highlight}Echoing Hatred{/c}.
The {c_highlight}difficulty{/c} rises as you defeat enemies. Kill as many enemies as you can before you become {c_highlight}overwhelmed{/c} and the challenge ends.
